scope.supports: Kernel-checked for arbitrary types in Type (universe 0): s factors through p only if s is constant on the fibres of p (collapsed_observation_barrier, re-proved as barrier); the converse holds whenever the task codomain Z is inhabited and fails in the instance X empty, Y = Unit, Z empty; the exact criterion for every Z is fibre-constancy together with (Z inhabited or Y empty) (factors_iff_exact), and factoring through the image of p is unconditional (factorsImage_iff); if s factors through a refined profile (p, t) then t separates every collapsed pair that s separates (tag_separates); for finite X, inhabited Z and a nonempty tag alphabet T, a tag with s factoring through (p, t) exists iff every profile fibre has at most card T distinct s values (tag_alphabet_iff; lower bound tag_card_lower_bound, existence tag_exists), so the least nonempty alphabet is max(1, largest number of distinct s values in one fibre). Native: exhaustive tables for fifteen carrier-size triples (all profiles, all tasks, all factors g, and all tags t up to the first alphabet size that works; the tag test uses the fibre-constancy criterion, cross-checked against g-enumeration in the tests) with zero barrier exceptions and the exact histogram of least alphabet sizes. In the histogram, key 0 means the empty alphabet works, which happens exactly for empty X (records (0,0,1) and (0,1,0)); record (2,0,2) has no profile at all and an empty histogram; for nonempty X the key is max(1, ...).
scope.does_not_support: Which tag or instance is added (the node does not select one, and the paper only exhibits predicates under a supplied decoder); the barrier for the inscription strings of the Pre-Genesis paper; infinite or non-function observation structures; universes above Type; any claim that an added tag exists in the physical or inscription regime; the source aggregate pg_collapse_barrier_protected_questions_and_l1_kkt_trace_embed, which is a bundle of fixed instances proved by rfl and decide.
scope.narrowest_claim: For maps p : X -> Y and s : X -> Z, no function of p reproduces s as soon as one fibre of p contains two points with different s values; with Z inhabited this is the only obstruction, and for finite X a nonempty tag alphabet of size k recovers s through (p, t) exactly when every fibre has at most k distinct s values.
scope.next_test: Confirm by exhaustive enumeration over the inscription strings <a>, <ab>, <aa> of the Pre-Genesis paper under the supplied decoder that the least tag alphabet equals the max-fibre value predicted by tag_alphabet_iff, and that the paper predicates "contains b" and "payload length > 1" achieve it.
